sources.title: Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering
sources.provider: Purdue University official BuildingShapesZip4 ArcGIS FeatureServer
sources.method: Converted feature vertices from Web Mercator to lon/lat, then Purdue project local tangent approximation; subtracted manifest placement marker (-109.0, 400.1893310547), zero marker rotation. Area computed after local projection.
sources.uncertainty: Building polygon supports a ground footprint boundary. It does not define facade wall lines, courtyard voids, upper-floor plans, or exact entrance position. Used only as a thin ground-level plate, not extruded walls.

sources.title: Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering structural project description
sources.source_date: Project completed 2006; source page current at retrieval
sources.crs: Not applicable; project description and photographs
evidence: Three-story cast-in-place frame with steel mechanical penthouse and basement/partial sub-basement.
Exposed concrete bridge at two levels through atrium and three concrete stairs.
sources.method: Used to relabel/reposition existing model slabs as two atrium bridge levels and to guide source-supported massing/roof interpretation. Bridge positions, routes and stair locations remain schematic; page provides no dimensioned plan.

sources.title: Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering case history
sources.provider: Design and Build With Metal / Arconic
evidence: High roof described as a warped wing-like cantilever on both ends, clad in Mayflower Red ACM.
Atrium ceiling described as 53 feet high.
Canopy/vestibule clad in Sea Wolf ACM.
sources.method: Roof slab mesh reshaped to qualitative tapered/warped wing profile with restrained edge lift and small illustrative overhang; exact curvature/overhang is not measured. R1 53 ft atrium datum and materials preserved.

sources.title: 3D anamorphic video wall features Purdue’s most consequential engineers
sources.crs: Not applicable; current interior exhibit description
evidence: New anamorphic LED video wall installed inside Armstrong atrium in 2025.
A specific floor sticker/viewing point guides visitors; screen described as flush in brick wall above doorway.
sources.method: Recorded as current exhibit evidence; not geometrically added in R2 because available source gives screen dimensions but not a registered wall/door location in the current source asset.

sources.title: ARMS – Armstrong Hall Building Emergency Plan
sources.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
evidence: Four levels: lower level, at grade, and two upper floors.
sources.method: Context for interior floors only; no floor plates or elevations.

sources.title: Neil A. Armstrong Papers finding aid, MSA 5
sources.provider: Purdue University Libraries Karnes Archives and Special Collections
sources.source_date: Finding aid revised 2017-08-15; Box 348 item refers to September 2004
evidence: The finding aid lists “Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering, Purdue University,” development plans, September 2004, Box 348, item 5 (PDF page 303).
sources.method_and_uncertainty: This confirms a relevant archival plan set exists, but the finding aid does not include the drawings. No measured plan or elevation was available to this revision; request/inspect the physical or digitized Box 348 item before changing wall outlines, upper floor plates, or roof curvature.

r2_changes.change: Added GIS-traced thin base footprint to existing atrium floor mesh.
r2_changes.basis: Official feature 642 footprint and manifest marker transform.
r2_changes.uncertainty: Ground footprint polygon only; no claims about wall lines, holes, or upper levels.

r2_changes.change: Repositioned existing two slabs/rails toward atrium center to represent the structural source’s two exposed bridge levels.
r2_changes.basis: Structural engineer page says exposed concrete bridge at two levels through atrium.
r2_changes.uncertainty: Exact bridge route/coordinates unsupported; current centerline is a renderable schematic.

r2_changes.change: Rebuilt existing red roof slab meshes as tapered, warped winglike surfaces.
r2_changes.basis: Project case history and 2007 building photos identify a winglike cantilever roof.
r2_changes.uncertainty: Exact roof curvature, tip shape, and overhang are not dimensioned; modeled profile is qualitative.

validation: See validation_r2.json. Individual asset saved and reopened before validation and renders. Master file and shared project files were not written.
